purpose: Role separation for the Parallel-Run Protocol duplicate gate (GEMSDOE32 IR-42-UNIQ-01 / DIPDUAL IR-DIPDUAL-LATTICE-01). The forward 3-px overlap test discriminates lane drift only between like-for-like dotted submissions; applied to covering blankets it is mathematically unsatisfiable and is reported as a diagnostic instead.

roles.discrete_submission: Dotted/sparse candidate raster with <=100000 positive footprint pixels. Duplicate gate applies: forward 3-px overlap >0.70 or |Spearman| >0.90 (surface and dots) = duplicate/stop.
roles.calibration_probe: Synthetic covering grid (13GEMSDOE r13-lattice-s5, 206895 dots, within 3 px of 99.8713% of footprint cells). Forward overlap measured and published; never sufficient alone to declare lane drift. Minimum possible forward overlap at N dots is (N-6649)/N (82.34% at N=37654).
roles.blanket_or_parent_mask: Thick binary mask or continuous surface with >100000 positive footprint pixels (e.g. H19-5 121131-px parent mask, of which B2 is a dotted subset). Reported with forward/reverse/Jaccard; subset relationships recorded explicitly.

selector_note: This file does not override the literal protocol for any other session. It records this session's explicit, evidence-backed deviation: lattice literal overlap is published in every run card (lattice_duplicate_literal) and the selector must acknowledge it before any slot is spent.
